description: HP-46 is the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) for the Bharmour sub-division in the Chamba district of Himachal Pradesh. Operated under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), it manages vehicle registration and driving licenses for this high-altitude Himalayan region.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Magistrate, Bharmour, District Chamba, Himachal Pradesh
